_comment: Device auto-detect table for the RE7 port. SnapdragonProfile.java is the runtime source of truth; this file documents the mapping.
_scope: Wide Snapdragon: Adreno 6xx (Pad 5 / 860) through 8 Elite Gen 5. One APK, multiple Turnip packs, auto-pick + manual override.

screen_policy.phone: Always 1600x720 (exactly 20:9). Any wide phone-like panel (AR >= ~19:9) or swDp < 600.
screen_policy.tablet: Height fixed at 800; width = round(800 * panel_landscape_AR), even dims. e.g. Pad 5 16:10 -> 1280x800.
screen_policy.stretch: fullscreenStretched=true so Wine fills the physical panel after SGSR/CAS.

turnip_packs.turnip-oneui7-8gen2: Weab-chan OneUI7 / Adreno 740 (8 Gen 2) — proven on CPH2585
turnip_packs.turnip26.3.0-oneui: StevenMXZ Mesa 26.3 OneUI — 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750 ONLY (not Elite)
turnip_packs.turnip-a8xx-v31: whitebelyash turnip/gen8 V31 — Adreno 810/825/829/830/840 (8 Elite / Elite Gen 5)
turnip_packs.turnip26.2.0: Generic Mesa Turnip — Adreno 6xx + unknown fallback

devices.notes: Adreno 840 — same A8xx pack as Elite; not Gen 3
Do NOT use turnip-oneui7-8gen2 — that pack is Adreno 740 UBWC/OEM-tuned.

devices.form: phone or tablet by panel AR / swDp
phone or tablet by panel AR / swDp

fallback.behavior: auto-pick generic Turnip; user can override on boot splash

shared_re7_preset.dxvk: async + state cache, no HUD, SAFEFLAGS=2
shared_re7_preset.wine_fex: bundled Proton arm64ec / FEXCore — same binaries all devices
